pieces.Text: Though you feel comfortable among all sorts of lowlifes, you rely on your intellect to defraud others. Whether you work the streets alone, in a small group, or as the brains behind a larger organization, you analyze opportunities and unapologetically exploit the system to achieve your ends. As a grifter, you're an expert in one or two trades, but you also have the knowledge and confidence to convincingly pass as an authority in just about any profession.
